test_title: PYST 64: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the father of B’

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’

Which of the following options means 'P is the mother of L'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 @
 &
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Father
 Sister
 
 

 

Option 1: S @ L & R # P

It means: S is the Wife of L, L is the Father of R, R is the Sister of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04ec44f910db055c07e8dcee950c4d4d3e86bcb6bbca4c2e030fddd93141c36f.png] 

Here, P is the Child of L.

**Option 2: P @ R & S # L**

It means: P is the Wife of R, R is the Father of S, S is the Sister of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b2f2830d28bc186973c3284b4b1cfec37053db24c2273f54171f337444c4e24.png] 

**Here, P is the Mother of L.**

Option 3: P @ L & S # R 

It means: P is the Wife of L, L is the Father of S, S is the Sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f795ef36fbaacb1b30941feebd4b22f553e221731cd5155cc09fc955663e333.png] 

Here, P is the wife of L.

Option 4: S @ P # R & L 

It means: S is the Wife of P, P is the Sister of R, R is the Father of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f849c2f01918870310f3e0a1d8f267c9962c582bbdb43b749060f81b9a82c58.png] 

Since, P is the Husband of S, so P is a male therefore, P can't be the sister of R.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
